absent: Dispatch queue structure layout and creation and destruction lifecycle
Normal enqueue and dispatch enqueue helpers including bypass handling
Scheduler operation callback set and their expected effects
Capability computation and topology mapping helpers
Deferred local dispatch processing and activation of deferred work
Rescue task selection and quantum and halflife configuration values
Direct dispatch clearing helper and sticky processor handling
Slice keep helper and unbounded slice representation

findings.text: A blocking helper is provided that waits until a task leaves the dispatching operation state, returning immediately when the task is not in that state.

A runqueue scoped helper drains the reject queue and resubmits each task through the normal enqueue path with a capability related requeue reason, while a header variant provides an empty fallback when subordinate schedulers are unavailable.

A capability revocation check reports whether a task on a given runqueue lacks required enqueue capabilities and records the missing set plus the originating topology identifier, with a header fallback that always reports no revocation.
A runqueue scoped accounting helper charges execution time against a bounded rescue budget and maintains a decaying per processor usage average, with a header fallback that performs no accounting.
A helper places a task into the resolved local dispatch queue of a destination runqueue, choosing head or tail placement from enqueue modifiers and completing runqueue owned post enqueue handling.

Direct dispatch targeting the local queue of a different processor is deferred to a per runqueue pending list with later deferred processing instead of acquiring a second runqueue lock while holding the current one.

Runqueue membership uses tail insertion into a runnable list with a negative marker when absent, coupled to a queued flag and a running count, preserving arrival order required by bypass and offline handling.

Out of band slice requests carry scheduler identity alongside duration and a pending marker, are installed atomically, and are discarded on application when the owning scheduler no longer matches the task owner.
Requeue passes assign a single reason for each resubmitted task, clearing any prior reason markers before assignment and removing the marker again after the enqueue completes.
Queued tasks in the priority indexed dispatch structure are ordered by ascending dispatch virtual time.

Rescue service is measured as executed runtime since a snapshot against a configured slice floored at zero, with oversized tick charges clamped and long term usage tracked by a halflife decayed average.

Direct dispatch records slice and timing plus target and flags only when the supplied task matches the task currently on the enqueue path, otherwise reporting a scheduler error and leaving prior state untouched.

Required enqueue capability depends on immediacy, with immediate tasks needing a separate immediate variant and others needing the standard variant, while tasks that cannot migrate plus the dedicated rescue task bypass the check entirely.

Local requeue decisions exempt protected tasks and the rescue task, track first examination of the current pass, prefer immediate and capability revocation causes, and otherwise follow generic request flags, while user queue decisions follow only the generic request flags.
Event accounting increments a per processor scheduler counter and emits a trace record carrying the event identity and count.

Removal of a task from a dispatch queue requires holding both the owning runqueue and the queue lock, and user queue reprocessing preserves this pairing while migrating the runqueue lock to follow each task.

Deferred user requeue requests are drained under a dedicated per runqueue spinlock with list removal and flag clearing done inside the critical section and a memory barrier before the queue is examined.
Deferred interrupt work acquires the associated runqueue lock before running deferred handlers and releases it afterwards through the scheduler specific drop and unlock sequence.
Insertion into the runnable list and recording of the runnable processor require holding the runqueue lock so the recorded processor remains stable across remote wakeups.

Task operation state moves among idle and queueing and queued and dispatching conditions, with direct dispatch resetting idle or queueing toward idle and dequeue handling queued through compare exchange or waiting for dispatch completion toward idle.

Enqueue sets runnable membership and the queued marker before invoking scheduler arrival callbacks and core dispatch, while dequeue clears membership and operation state before invoking departure callbacks and clearing the queued marker and slice state.

Slice state starts from out of band installation with clamping of unbounded and oversized values, is applied on the runqueue with capability checks for increases, is consumed by execution accounting unless unbounded, and is terminated by yield and dequeue transitions.

Scheduler class entry points handle task arrival and departure and voluntary yield and directed yield and wakeup preemption, integrating runnable tracking and slice termination with optional scheduler callbacks.
Current execution accounting applies any pending out of band slice before measuring elapsed time, then consumes bounded slice and charges rescue and server accounting when applicable.
An interrupt work handler provides an entry point that runs deferred scheduler work in runqueue context.

Enqueueing directly to a remote local queue while holding the current runqueue would need a second runqueue lock, so the design defers that case and resets transient operation state with consistency warnings on unexpected states.

Waiting for dispatch completion happens while holding a runqueue lock, so completion must proceed without that lock, and queued tasks observed without custody are retried briefly because the final idle update may still be in flight on another processor.

User queue rescanning aborts when bypass is active, validates that the task was not lost across runqueue lock migration, and periodically releases locks and relaxes the processor to avoid long hold times.

A dispatch queue may be destroyed concurrently with deferred requeue processing, so the queue identifier is rechecked after the barrier and invalid queues are skipped while builtin queues are treated as a programming error.

Preemption by a higher priority class takes no action on same class wakeups but triggers local requeue processing when immediate tasks are present, covering running and waking and in progress dispatch cases.
Out of band slice encoding uses forty three low bits for duration with masks and shifts derived from that width, a middle field for scheduler identity, and the top bit as a pending marker.

Per task scheduler state logically groups direct dispatch stash for target and slice and timing and flags with an atomic out of band slice word and runnable linkage and dispatch linkage and flag and counter fields.
Per runqueue scheduler state logically groups a runnable list and running counts with deferred local and user requeue lists and a reject list plus rescue budget and snapshot and event counters.
